name: zrndr_span_alpha_blend_565_const_alpha_from_tex16_alpha8
description: zRndr::SpanAlphaBlend565ConstAlphaFromTex16Alpha8 blends 16-bit texture data into a 5:6:5 destination span using alpha-map coverage scaled by constant alpha.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification currently fails: original 0x49c970 is 284 bytes, the compiled source loop is 240 bytes, 52 relocation bytes are masked, 13 trailing VC NOPs are trimmed, and 220 unmasked byte mismatches remain.

The mismatch is explained by source-shape/codegen limits: the source preserves the verified tex16 index and 5:6:5 blend through shared helpers, but VC5SP3 emits helper calls, a different float-to-int conversion sequence, zero-count loop guarding, and different stack/register allocation instead of the retail routine's fully inlined x87-bias span loop.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49c970 validates 16-bit texel sampling from g_spanActiveTexels, source index construction from texU >> 20 plus masked texV shifted by texVShift, alpha-map lookup from g_spanActiveTexAlphaMap, texU/texV step advancement, and destination advancement.

The original multiplies the alpha-map byte by the float alpha scale stored in g_spanActiveConstAlphaBits, converts it to an integer blend factor, skips writes for scaled alpha <= 3, copies the source texel for scaled alpha values at least 252, and otherwise blends 5:6:5 channels toward the destination.
The native smoke verifies scaled alpha-map blending, full-alpha copy, low-alpha skip, and that g_spanCurrentDst16 is not advanced by the source-faithful implementation.
